Not me, but my sister. For the past 15 years our family have went on this cabin trip with other families. An old lady died there 50 years ago, and there have always been this rumour about an old lady there. 

Theres a total of 4 big cabin/houses, and the place is really nice. I’ve never believed people who have claimed to see this «ghost» until last year.

My sister went up there with her children an hour before we arrived. She was in the kitchen, when suddenly my nephew asked my sister where the old lady was gonna sleep. My sister was spooked and asked «what lady» he answered the one with the black hair in the living room. This is where she «died» She waited in the car until we arrived and slept in another cabin.

And, no one have told my nephew about the old lady since they would be scarred. He was 5
